items.html: Afterward, the second phase is the first Hey of HaVaYaH, encompassing the expansion of the Mochin as mentioned above, and it is called Bina, which is the Lamed of Tzelem. Indeed, this too includes within it the third phase below it, which is the Tzadi of Tzelem, and is called Tzal. It lacks from it only the Mem of Tzelem, for it is higher than it and is called Tzal, but its essence is the Lamed of Tzelem alone.
